content: Ben-Gay, also known as Bengay in its more recent spelling, is a topical analgesic heat rub designed to alleviate muscle and joint pain. It was originally formulated in France by Dr. Jules Bengué and introduced to the United States in 1898. The product was initially manufactured by Pfizer Consumer Healthcare, which was later acquired by Johnson & Johnson. The active ingredients in Bengay vary depending on the specific formulation of the product: 1. Bengay Original contains 15% methyl salicylate and 10% menthol. 2. Bengay Muscle Pain/Ultra Strength contains 30% methyl salicylate, 10% menthol, and 4% camphor. 3. Bengay Ice Extra Strength contains 10% menthol. 4. Bengay Muscle Pain/No Odour contains 15% triethanolamine salicylate. 5. Bengay Arthritis Extra Strength contains 30% methyl salicylate and 8% menthol. It is important to note that methyl salicylate, one of the active ingredients, can be toxic if the cream is applied excessively.
